description:
FOUND s502 (Fable, 2026-09-30) by the s501 review probe `r500a-proto.pl` row `set`: perl prints `set '$$' undef`, PCL prints `set undef undef` on main c0edaf75 AND on the s500a tree (NOTES.md expected #2533 to cover it; #2533 registers prototypes at DEFINITION and made `prototype()` read the registry -- it did not touch the shim).

    use Scalar::Util qw(set_prototype); sub sp { 1 }
    set_prototype(\&sp, '$$');  print prototype(\&sp);   # perl '$$'   PCL undef
    set_prototype(\&sp, undef); print prototype(\&sp);   # perl undef  PCL undef

lib/Scalar/Util.pm line 80 (main): `sub set_prototype { }` -- an empty body, i.e. a STUB, which the runtime rule forbids ("Runtime = real Perl semantics only, no stubs"). lib/Sub/Util.pm line 45 already does it right: `sub set_prototype { my ($proto, $code) = @_; return __pcl_set_prototype($code, $proto) }` -- NOTE THE ARGUMENT ORDER DIFFERS between the two modules (Scalar::Util: `set_prototype(\&fn, $proto)`, coderef FIRST, returns the reference; Sub::Util: `set_prototype($proto, $code)`, proto first). The fix is the one-line shim body with Scalar::Util's order, returning the code ref (perl: "Sets the prototype of the function given by the $code reference ... returns $code"), and `set_prototype(\&f, undef)` must CLEAR it (probe: `prototype(\&f)` undef afterwards, and a call `f(@list)` that a `($)` prototype would have coerced to scalar is a list call again -- prototypes are compile-time in perl, so the observable effect is only through `prototype()` and through string-eval'd calls compiled after the set; both are the guard rows).

LAYER: `lib/` shim (rule 9a -- one module's behaviour). BARS: a `lib/` change makes the FULL SWEEP non-optional (invisible to corpus-diff); `tools/emission-ab.pl --ref <base> --list lib/Scalar/Util.pm`; guard rows in Pl/t/transpile-test-10.t (where the s500a isweak/openhandle rows went) or the next file by wall time, inverse-verified. Filed alongside #2537 (list-valued `use constant` returns its last element).


=== DONE (s502e, Opus, 2026-10-04) ===
SHIPPED: lib/Scalar/Util.pm `sub set_prototype { my ($code, $proto) = @_; return __pcl_set_prototype($code, $proto) }` -- Scalar::Util's order (code ref first), returns the code ref, undef clears.  emission-ab over lib/Scalar/Util.pm + lib/Sub/Util.pm SAME.
PROBES (scratch/s502e/p/sp.pl): set / clear / '' / anon sub / chained call == perl; base differs.  The r500a-proto.pl review probe is now identical to perl in every row (`set` and `parse`).
CONSEQUENCE: #2084 item (1) (Memoize) -- Memoize::_wrap installs `Scalar::Util::set_prototype(sub {...}, prototype $orig)`, i.e. set_prototype's RETURN value; the stub made memoize install nothing.
NOT FIXED, FILED #2610: a prototype set at RUN time (BEGIN { set_prototype(\&sp, '$$') }) is reported by prototype() but never changes how later calls parse, string evals included (not-supported.md prototype() residue (3)).
GUARD: Pl/t/transpile-test-10.t row 77 (inverse-verified).


=== s502e resume (s507, claude-opus-5-5) ===
Review fix (Fable s507 probe e2-proto row 09): Scalar::Util::set_prototype and Sub::Util::set_prototype now croak "set_prototype: not a reference" for a non-reference and "set_prototype: not a subroutine reference" for a non-CODE reference, as the XS does (probed vs perl for both modules: string, [1], \$x, undef). Guard Pl/t/transpile-test-10.t row 78, inverse-verified failing on the 2e71d4aa extraction. (PCL Carp::croak omits the " at FILE line N." suffix -- pre-existing Carp text, not this fix.)
subject: lib/Scalar/Util.pm `set_prototype` is an EMPTY STUB (`sub set_prototype { }`) -- a silent no-op, while lib/Sub/Util.pm`s is real (calls __pcl_set_prototype); make it real now that #2533 registers per-definition prototype facts
